editorial_contributions.text:
Summary: The problem of estimation of parametric functions in two-dimensional plane is discussed. For a measurable design, a new estimator for estimating the variance of the Horvitz-Thompson estimator is suggested. The variance of the resultant estimator is discussed and compared with the Sen-Yates-Grundy estimator for a fixed sample design. An improved estimator of variance of the general linear regression estimator is also suggested.

 Techniques for estimating the ratio of two variances, the regression coefficient and the proportion of values within a specified region of a plane are also discussed. A simulation stady has been carried out to support the ideas presented in the present investigation. The idea of obtaining different strategies is an extension of the pioneering methodology of \textit{V. P. Godambe} [Can. J. Stat. 23, 227--243 (1995; Zbl 0836.62010)] from one-dimensional to two-dimensional spaces.

title.title: Estimation of parametric functions in two-dimensional space in survey sampling
